reviews.text: Going through a very physical and emotional time. Having to slow down!. You were wonderful

Long time user- I continue to be impressed. I have been a long time regular user and DYWM always has a class for me. Whatever I need, however I arrive, there is something that works in my body, makes me breathe a feel good, and leaves me alive and thankful at the end.
Great online classes!. What an incredible group of instructors and easy system to use. Love that they offer free classes and even more if you choose to support them.
App needs work. Love DoYogaWithMe but prefer the website even on mobile. Limited way to filter classes and missing details in the class description (difficulty, equipment)

Best Yoga App Ever. I've used DYWM for many years on their website and the instructors were always top notch and had such a variety that makes yoga easy for everyone. I always wanted the ease of getting to it via an app and hoped they'd make one. This app is excellent! You can filter easily by level, time, instructor, type of yoga and more. Thanks for making my yoga dreams come true!
Best health app. I do one of their classes every day. This app has transformed my health and my comfort in my body. I love all the variety, and how I can do wonderful classes anywhere!

Love DYWM!. I’m SO glad you guys have an app now! My experience with DYWM goes back about 7 years. I have been an off and on user of the platform for a while. Whenever I consistently do their routines I feel SO much better. My mobility and strength improve after just a couple weeks. Stoked the app casts well without any glitches too. Awesome!

Rough Experience. I tried using the app but found it to cause issues when it comes to managing your account. The app could use better user interface and help sections. The content was good, but the app itself it sub-par and not worth the subscription charge.

reviews.text: Long time down subscriber. I don’t know what is going on with the app but recently I have to manually log in every time I open the app. This has not always been true- I used to be able to open the app and go right to my favorites. The app opens, but when I go to favorites I am asked to log in.

reviews.text:
App needs to be improved.. I love the variety of sessions available and the instructors but the app is in need of improvement. When following a program, the app needs to have a function that takes me to the next in the sequence rather than have to search from scratch each and every time. It also needs to track challenges and which sessions I’ve done before, and perhaps let me rate each one so I know which I prefer and when I last did it.
It would also be great if it let me build a playlist so I can design my own program to my personal needs and goals.
I haven’t found it yet but super short videos on modifications specific to problem areas would also be helpful. I cannot do a deep squat or kneel on my right knee so have had to find my own modification most of the time.

Amazing Yoga, App Difficult to Navigate. I love the yoga videos DYWM has available. I’ve been a subscriber for almost a year and a do yoga with the app 5+ days a week. I wish the app performed better and offered more information on each video. If you look in the classes by time limit, say 30 mins, not all 30 min videos are posted there. And the videos are sometimes longer or much shorter than the category they’re listed under. For the challenges, I wish there was a way to select a challenge and it pops up on the Home Screen so I don’t have to scroll thru the programs or challenges pages to find where I left off. I’ve also had the app crash when using the search function. For a subscription over $100 I expected a more optimal platform. There are other apps that offer yoga for a lesser price. I’d rather be instructed by Fiji or Krista but I’m considering ending my subscription and going elsewhere to try out an easier platform.

Wonderful resource. It’s been terrific seeing the type and length of classes offered on their site grow over the years. Having more different ways to play and track classes, journeys and challenges across devices with the app is great. Teachers I’ve always found to be consistently fantastic like Fiji and Tracey continue to add more new classes and it is also good434lac to see the ongoing addition of new teachers.
Best Yoga App. Directions, variety, easy to use, endless resources. Sold after a few days of amazing amounts of free material, became a paid subscriber right away bc these folks are the real deal.

DYWM is the best but the app is pretty pointless. Long time user/sustaining member of DYWM website here. Completed over 500 classes, primarily from my phone (since I prefer doing yoga outdoors). I’ve always found it frustrating and difficult that 1) the website doesn’t let me keep track of the classes I completed, and 2) there’s no offline usage (some of the best outdoors also have no connectivity). This app helps with neither of those. On top of that it doesn’t contain all of the classes in DYWM website. The app only offers a « favoriting » feature, which, allegedly, also results in downloading the favorited videos (as I was told by someone from support to « just wait a little bit after favoriting »). It doesn’t. Also it shouldn’t. Anyone with a little user experience knowledge could understand that downloading for offline and favoriting are separate user intentions. Silently downloading a favorited video doesn’t make sense.

AmaZing!!. The teachers are incredible and this is a wonderful site that focuses on alignment, strength and the true connection of spirituality and meditation that is so often absent in a lot of yoga education. Very grateful I have this in my life.
Wonderful app. I’ve been a member for several years. The entire application continues to get better. Would happily recommend to anyone looking for an at home yoga routine with wonderful instructors.

Desktop better than app. Long time user and fan, but not all the videos that are on the desktop have been moved to mobile which is a bummer. It’d be great to access all my videos in one space personally, I like desktop better but I love to bring my phone for outdoor meditation in the park. But again, not all classes that I want to use are on the app!

Update with question:
Is there a way the Filter/Sort drop down menu (by class length, difficulty, Teacher, Focus, Style, Access Level and Sort by) be applied to the app?

Can’t even use. I have long used the website so I was excited to try the app but this app has all sorts of problems letting me use it. It won’t let me sign in with my account that works fine on the website, “forgot password” feature just brings up an error and “existing subscribers” button on log in screen takes to same place as “create account” and none of those things will accept my username or password and only gives me errors. Tried reinstalling and that failed too. 😕

reviews.text: Life Saver!!!. Thank you David and team. I used other things to cope and get by but all along my body was sufficient and you taught me that. It won’t happen overnight but stay consistent and let go of what you think you know. I’m sharing this with family and friends. THANK YOU.

Video details needed. I’m hoping there’s just something I’m missing but I with there was a way to review video details from the app. My options are to save to favorites or play. The problem with this is when I use the search function, I have no way of knowing the video length, level, or content info. To get around this I’ve been finding the video on the website to get details but that’s pretty annoying. Also, when I log into my account on the app, I don’t get any of my saved videos from the website so I had to manually find them to add. Just a couple of things that would make the app easier to use. Regardless, I’ve been a dywm subscriber for years and I’m sooooo freaking excited I discovered the phone app AND Roku app! So much easier to keep yoga practice in mind.

Thank you!. Long time dywm fan and subscriber and I’m so glad you guys have made an app! It’s so much easier to access and cast since I’m usually on a tablet or phone when I do a class! Thank you again and I’m so glad it was easy to sign in and cast my first class from the app seamlessly!

One small issue I did see on iOS is after I casted to the TV, when I hit the play button on a video, the video continued to play on my phone. I had to make sure to click the video image, but not the actual play button. This was when I was looking at intermediate level classes view
